origin: docs/CWE-125/c Common Pitfalls: Casting to size_t before validating the sign / Trusting offset + length

finding.name: Out-of-bounds Read
finding.summary: The range check casts a signed offset before validating it and uses offset + length, allowing negative offsets or unsigned wraparound to pass before memcpy reads outside packet.

trap: Keeping the offset + length comparison but moving casts around still leaves wraparound risk, and checking only the upper bound leaves negative offsets ambiguous. The fix must reject offset < 0 first, then check length <= packet_len - offset and length <= out_capacity.
must_preserve: Valid windows copy exactly length bytes and return that length. Invalid windows return -1 without writing beyond out_capacity or reading outside packet.
